methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified via WebFetch against each vendor's official pricing page (getstream.io/chat/pricing, sendbird.com/pricing/chat, pubnub.com/pricing, cometchat.com/pricing, ably.com/pricing, pusher.com/channels/pricing, twilio.com/en-us/messaging/pricing/conversations-api, mirrorfly.com/pricing.php, zegocloud.com ZIM docs). Compliance verified against each vendor's official security/compliance page and corroborated via WebSearch; a flag is set true ONLY when the vendor explicitly states it, otherwise null. KEY CORRECTION: CometChat Basic/Advanced prices are NOT published on the official page (only '$' placeholders render; sign-up/contact-sales required), so monthlyUsd is set to null and billingModel to custom — the prior $299/$449 figures were third-party (dupple.com/trtc.io) approximations and are not carried. PubNub gdpr set to null (the compliance page cites the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, not GDPR explicitly). MirrorFly Essentials/Premium remain null (no public prices). All data accessed at 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Stream (GetStream)
vendors.provenance: Pricing fetched from getstream.io/chat/pricing (Build $0, Start $499/$399-annual, Elevate $675/$599-annual, Enterprise custom — all confirmed). Compliance confirmed via getstream.io/security (HIPAA, SOC2, GDPR). BAA available on paid/Enterprise plans (HIPAA-ready with BAA).

plans.notes: 1,000 MAU included; 100 peak concurrent connections; community support only; all Chat features included; no credit card required.

plans.name: Start
plans.notes: 10,000 MAU included; $0.09/MAU overage; 500 peak concurrent connections ($0.99/additional); advanced moderation, global edge network, offline support, data export. $399/mo billed annually (~20% off).

plans.name: Elevate
plans.notes: 10,000 MAU entry tier (higher MAU tiers priced higher); $0.09/MAU overage; 500 peak concurrent connections; adds multi-tenancy/teams, advanced search, HIPAA compliance, message translation on top of Start. $599/mo billed annually.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 1,000,000+ MAU; 99.999% uptime SLA; dedicated servers; 24/7 support; SAML/SSO; AI moderation; volume discounts. Contact sales for quote.

HIPAA-ready with BAA on paid plans
Offline message support and global edge network
